title: Integrate history saving into loop runner
description: After each iteration completes, save the accumulated output to a history file. Generate a sessionId at the start of the loop using Date.now().
acceptanceCriteria: sessionId is generated at loop start using Date.now()
After each iteration, saveIteration() is called with the iteration output
History file exists at .agent/history/ITERATION-{sessionId}-{n}.txt after each iteration
History files contain the iteration output with ANSI codes stripped

steps.description: Generate sessionId at start of runLoop
steps.details: At the top of runLoop: `const sessionId = Date.now().toString()`
Inside the iteration for loop, maintain a local variable: `let iterationOutput = ''`. Append each output line: iterationOutput += line + '\n'
After the AI process completes for an iteration: `await saveIteration(options.agentDir, sessionId, i, iterationOutput)`. This runs before checking exit conditions.
